Their current line-up includes Paul Banks, Daniel Kessler, and Sam Fogarino. Their name is a reference to the European crime-fighting organization - chosen after considering alternate names including Las Armas and The French Letters. With notable hits under their belt including "Evil," "NYC," and "Slow Hands," Interpol is one of the more recognizable acts in modern post-punk. From their 2002 debut album Turn on the Bright Lights through to their most recent release, 2018's Marauder, Interpol remains a band worth listening to.
